Gao and Zhao (1.2) improved Baier and Young’s result (1.1) by employing double
Dirichlet series. They established the functional equation for cubic L-function in terms
of double Dirichlet series, whose coeﬃcients are generalized Gauss sums. This method
allows them to meromorphically continue the underlying double Dirichlet series to a
larger region without altering it. This approach was ﬁrst used by Soundararajan [10],
and later by ˇCech [4] to study the ratios conjecture for real Dirichlet characters.
Motivated by [6], we adjust the approach of Gao and Zhao to investigate the ﬁrst
moment of cubic L-functions in the function ﬁeld setting. By employing double Dirichlet
series, we improve the result (1.3) and prove the following theorem:

2. Preliminary
In this section, we will recall some standard properties of Gauss sums and functional
equation for L-functions. The proofs are not the focus of this paper and one can easily
ﬁnd the proofs, for example [5, 6, 11], so we omit them. Readers are advised to pay
particular attention to the quantitative relationships encapsulated by these properties,
as they play a critical role in the subsequent computational analysis.
In this paper, we work in the non-Kummer setting, where q is an odd prime power
such that q ≡2 mod 3. For simplicity, we omit the corresponding results in the Kummer
setting. A similar asymptomatic for the ﬁrst moment of cubic L-functions in the Kummer
setting q ≡1 mod 3 can be obtained by analogous steps.
